_comment: Hand-authored curated sets, by title + platform. tools/collections.py resolves each title to every dump's CRC and writes collections/curated.json (which the app reads). Add sets freely; unresolved titles are printed on build and skipped. 'auto' entries are rules, not lists: kind 'short' takes every game under maxHours per hltb/hltb.json on the named platforms.
